headline: Senate passes mental health and aviation bills while Protect College Sports Act heads to Monday vote showdown!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed three bills including the John A. Hauser Mental Health in Aviation Act and the Aviation Medication Transparency Act. The chamber also considered the Protect College Sports Act with a cloture vote passing 74-25, setting up a final vote scheduled for Monday at approximately 5:30 PM.

onTheFloor.title: Protect College Sports Act - Protects student athlete name, image, and likeness rights and promotes fair competition in college athletics
onTheFloor.status: Cloture voted 74-25; final passage vote scheduled Monday at 5:30 PM

onTheFloor.title: John A. Hauser Mental Health in Aviation Act - Revises FAA regulations for individuals disclosing mental health diagnoses in aviation activities
Aviation Medication Transparency Act - Requires FAA to publish list of medications reviewed for airmen and air traffic control specialists certification
Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe Project Lands Restoration Act - Takes certain federal land in Washington into trust for the Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe
Directs President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran under War Powers Resolution

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly at 2:30 PM for a pro forma session, with no votes taken. The chamber adjourned at 2:33 PM. Three bills were reported from committee including measures on veteran healthcare certifications and student educational records.

onTheFloor.title: Requires Veterans Health Administration sterile processing technicians to hold appropriate professional certification
Prohibits educational institutions from withholding transcripts from students using Post-9/11 educational assistance
Ensures students are not required to submit surveys revealing personal information without prior written consent
